mainEntity.name: What Is EOAT and How Does It Affect Palletizer Payload?

acceptedAnswer.text: EOAT is the end-of-arm tool: the gripper, clamp, fork or vacuum head at the end of the robot arm that holds the case. Its own weight counts against the robot's payload, together with the case weight and, for multi-case picks, the combined weight of the cases. TRF validates the final payload with your product, gripper, pallet pattern and reach.

mainEntity.name: Can a Conveyor System Integrate With My Palletizer and Case Packer?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, and that is how TRF supplies conveyors: as engineered systems integrated into the line, never as loose components. TRFIntraflow modules handle conveying, accumulation, routing and elevation between machines, and end-of-line integration covers case packing, conveying and palletizing as one flow with one partner responsible.
